title: Twin Showdown
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ling's body began to turn transparent, her gaze toward Chen Ji filled with complex emotions—a mixture of reluctance, determination, and profound love.

text.content: In the Void, as the Heavenly Eye's cold smirk had yet to fade, Chen Ji felt a familiar aura spreading from behind him, one that made his heart palpitate. That aura resonated with his bloodline, echoed with his Tianji Record, intertwined with every strand of True Qi in his body—it was the aura of a fate-bound twin, the last existence in this world he was unwilling to face.

Chen Ling had appeared. Unlike the vague, Tianji Record-dependent phantom Chen Ji had imagined, she possessed a complete form, a plain white robe floating in the Void without wind, her features bearing seven-tenths resemblance to his yet more gentle, a golden mark flickering at her brow center—the mark of Heavenly Seal corruption. Her eyes were pure gold, without pupils, yet seemed capable of seeing through all cause and effect.

dialogue.content: Brother, you made me wait so long.

text.content: Her voice was calm as still water, yet it made Chen Ji's heart tighten abruptly. He instinctively stepped back half a pace, the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand trembling violently, as if warning him of something.

The Heavenly Eye let out a low chuckle nearby: "The twins are finally reunited. This drama should reach its climax now. Chen Ji, did you think you could escape destiny's arrangement? Chen Ling's existence itself is the final shackle prepared for you."

text.content: Chen Ji gripped the Tianji Record Fragment tightly, countless thoughts racing through his mind. Forced fusion would grant him power to overwhelm the Heavenly Eye instantly, but what difference would that make from those puppets he despised? Respecting independence was the right path, but in this life-or-death moment, separation might be the only way for both to survive—as long as Chen Ling ceased all connection with him, the Heavenly Eye would have no reason to continue hunting her.

dialogue.content: What? Still hesitating? The Heavenly Eye's voice carried mockery: "You pitiful twin children are merely two chess pieces I've arranged. Whatever choice you make, the ending was long destined. Chen Ling will disappear, you will become a new puppet, and the Tianji Record will return to my control."

text.content: Chen Ling shook her head slightly, her golden eyes gazing directly at the Heavenly Eye, her voice calm yet carrying undeniable power: "You are wrong, Heavenly Eye. Unlike my brother, I am an existence created by the observed one, not a mere appendage of the Tianji Record. Precisely because I share the same origin yet remain independent, I can see what you can never perceive—that is the possibility beyond destiny."

choices.text: Coldly mocking retort against the Heavenly Eye
choices.description: "You think I struggled for ten thousand years just to listen to your nonsense? Sorry, I already foresaw you would say that." Using words to tear apart the other party's arrogance.

choices.visible_reward: Gain deeper understanding of Chen Ling's abilities to provide basis for decision-making

text.content: Chen Ji noticed that the moment Chen Ling spoke those words, the Heavenly Eye's pupil slightly contracted—a trace of emotional fluctuation that hadn't occurred in hundreds of millions of years. The observer's independent existence clearly exceeded its expectations. What surprised Chen Ji even more was discovering subtle changes in the space surrounding Chen Ling: three faint rays of light extending from her body, pointing in three distinct directions, each representing a possible future.

The first ray glowed with warm golden light, connecting Chen Ji and her—that was the Path of Freedom: both maintaining independence while jointly breaking through Heavenly Dao's shackles. The second ray was dark as ink, linking Chen Ling to the Heavenly Eye—that was the Path of Replacement: Chen Ling replacing Chen Ji as the new observer. The third ray was an eerie silver-white, connecting to the depths of the void—that was the Path of Mutual Destruction: both disappearing simultaneously, causing the causal network to collapse completely.

dialogue.content: "Brother, can you see it? These three paths are the truth I can only reveal with all my strength." Chen Ling's voice carried a hint of exhaustion: "The Heavenly Eye is right—I am indeed the shackle prepared for you, but a shackle can also become a key. The choice is in your hands, and I... whatever you choose, I will accept."

text.content: Her gaze fell on Chen Ji, and those golden eyes suddenly shimmered with a layer of mist: "I don't want to disappear, brother. Throughout these ten thousand years, I survived alone in the crevices of fate, and the only thing sustaining me was the hope of one day meeting you. But I also know—if my existence becomes your burden, I am willing to dissipate."

choices.description: "No one should sacrifice for another, especially not my blood relative. Let's break this heaven together!" Fight side by side with Chen Ling.

choices.visible_reward: Chen Ling gains true free will, and Chen Ji completes his final redemption

choices.memory_label: 陈机选择牺牲自己，让陈灵获得解脱

text.content: At that moment, the Heavenly Eye suddenly erupted with world-destroying pressure. The three ribbons of light trembled violently under its oppression, on the verge of collapse. 'Enough!' Its voice roared like ten thousand thunderclaps: 'This One has no time to watch your meaningless sibling affection. Whatever you choose, today must see an end!'

Chen Ji felt that pressure crushing down like a mountain, the circulation of his true qi becoming sluggish, the text on the Tianji Record Fragment twisting and blurring. He gritted his teeth, calculating rapidly: the Heavenly Eye is desperate, it is afraid. Afraid of the possibilities Chen Ling represents, afraid of possibilities beyond fate. This means whichever path he chooses has a chance of success—the key lies in completing his choice before it can react.

dialogue.content: 'Chen Ji, this One grants you one final chance.' The Heavenly Eye's voice suddenly turned ice-cold: '融合主动与 Chen Ling willingly, become the true Observer, and this One may spare your life. Otherwise, you both will completely dissipate within this web of karma, not even having a chance at reincarnation!'

text.content: Upon hearing this, a cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips. He slowly raised his head, gazing directly at that enormous eye spanning the heavens: 'Ten thousand years of schemes, countless millions of years of calculations, yet in the end you must beg me to comply willingly? Heavenly Eye, the more you behave this way, the more certain I become—you are afraid.'

choices.text: Respond with mockery and choose the path of freedom
choices.description: "When has this Chen Ji ever feared you? Chen Ling, we walk our own path!" Launch the first strike, forcibly carving out a path to freedom.
choices.visible_cost: Risk being severely wounded by the Heavenly Eye
choices.visible_reward: Greatly increase the possibility of completely shattering the shackles of fate
choices.risk_hint: Will face the Heavenly Eye's full-scale counterattack

text.content: Upon hearing Chen Ji's words, a flash of joy appeared in Chen Ling's eyes. She extended her hand, golden light pouring from her palm, resonating with the power of the Tianji Record within Chen Ji's body. The two forces intertwined, forming a brilliant pillar of light that shot straight toward the heavens.

The Heavenly Eye let out a roar, and from its enormous pupil shot a jet-black arrow of karma, rushing straight toward Chen Ji. That arrow contained power sufficient to destroy stars—it was the Heavenly Eye's ultimate killing technique.

dialogue.content: "Brother, catch me!" Chen Ling shouted, her entire person transforming into a stream of light that plunged into the Tianji Record within Chen Ji. The two forces instantly merged as one, and unprecedented light erupted around Chen Ji—light containing the Observer's insight, the observed's freedom, and possibilities beyond fate.

text.content: The arrow of karma struck that layer of light, but instead of destroying Chen Ji as the Heavenly Eye had anticipated, it was broken down layer by layer by the light, dissolving into countless tiny particles that scattered into the void. The Heavenly Eye revealed shock for the first time: "Impossible! How can the Observer and the observed merge? This violates the fundamental laws of karma!"

text.content: Chen Ji felt the power surging within him - a brand new energy born from the fusion with Chen Ling. It was neither the pure power of the Tianji Record nor Chen Ling's Observer power, but a third possibility born from their perfect fusion - the possibility of transcending causality.

dialogue.content: "No... this is impossible!" For the first time, fear appeared in the voice of the Eye of Heavenly Dao: "I have plotted for hundreds of millions of years, manipulating countless epochs of rise and fall - how could I possibly lose to a mere human? To a pair of twins I myself created?" Its massive pupil spun frantically, attempting to re-lock onto Chen Ji's threads of causality, only to find them all vanished.

text.content: Chen Ji floats in the void, surrounded by interwoven golden and silver light. His voice remains calm yet carries undeniable authority: "Eye of Heavenly Dao, you committed a fatal mistake - you treated fate as an immutable script, yet forgot that even scripts require actors to perform. And actors possess will."

choices.text: Press the advantage and completely destroy

choices.visible_cost: May exhaust all strength
choices.visible_reward: Completely annihilate the Eye of Heavenly Dao, end all causality

choices.description: "Eye of Heavenly Dao, I give you a choice - retire beyond the causal web, or vanish forever. You choose."
choices.visible_cost: May grant the opponent a chance to catch their breath
choices.visible_reward: Display the bearing of a ruler, shatter the enemy's final will to resist

text.content: At this moment, Chen Ling's voice echoed in Chen Ji's mind, carrying a hint of hesitation: "Brother, I... can still sense those three paths. They haven't disappeared but have merged into our new existence. This means, regardless of what choice you make now, we have an escape route - or rather, we are no longer bound by a single choice."

A thought stirred in Chen Ji's heart. He sensed Chen Ling spoke truth - after fusion, they indeed retained multiple possibilities, and this multiplicity itself posed the greatest threat to the Eye of Heavenly Dao. Because it could only calculate determined futures, while they possessed the power of uncertainty.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji!" The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice rang out again, this time with an eerie calm: "You think you've won? You think fusion can escape my control? Let me tell you, the moment you twins fused, you carved a new mark in the causal web. I truly cannot fully lock onto you, but I can..." Its pupil constricted sharply: "I can lock onto Chen Ling!"

text.content: Chen Ji instantly understood the Eye of Heavenly Dao's intention. It couldn't lock onto him post-fusion, but it could lock onto Chen Ling - the Observer created as an independent existence. As long as Chen Ling still existed, it could trace this causality through her, thereby finding methods to deal with Chen Ji.

choices.description: "Chen Ling, come out. Fusion is good, but I cannot let you be eternally locked because of me." Proactively end the fusion to protect Chen Ling.

choices.visible_reward: Chen Ling gains true independence, the Eye of Heavenly Dao loses its only weakness
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao may seize this opportunity to counterattack

text.content: Chen Ling sensed Chen Ji's intention, urgently speaking within the fusion: "Brother, don't! I've finally managed to stand beside you, why would you give up?" Her voice carried confusion and anxiety.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji responded tenderly in his heart: "It's not giving up, Chen Ling. It's to set you truly free." He began to actively decompose the merged state, peeling Chen Ling's existence out from it.

text.content: Chen Ling's body gradually separated from within Chen Ji, but this time, she was no longer a vague silhouette, but a complete, independent life. What surprised Chen Ji even more was that on the separated Chen Ling, the golden light was more dazzling than before—the light of free will, proof that possibilities beyond fate had taken root in her.

choices.text: Let Chen Ling leave the battlefield
choices.description: "Chen Ling, go! Leave this place, find a place the Heavenly Eye cannot find." Sending her away from danger.

choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye will focus its attack on Chen Ling
choices.memory_label: 陈机与陈灵并肩作战

text.content: Seeing this scene, the Heavenly Eye roared furiously: "Foolish! Do you think you can escape like this? I tell you, as long as Chen Ling exists in this universe, I will never stop hunting her! Today you let her go, and tomorrow she will become your greatest weakness!"

Chen Ji coldly watched that wildly spinning eye, a mocking smile curling at his lips: "Is that so? Then come. But before that, let me tell you something—you think Chen Ling is our weakness, but you don't know she is now my greatest confidence. Because as long as she exists, your causal network can never be perfect. And imperfect causality is more terrifying to you than any enemy."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ling." Chen Ji turned to his sister, his voice calm yet resolute, "Go. Find a future that belongs to you alone. The Heavenly Eye cannot catch up to you, because you are a variable it cannot calculate."

text.content: Chen Ling's eyes glistened red, but she did not cry. She took a deep breath and bowed deeply to Chen Ji: "Brother, wait for me. When I find a way to counter the Heavenly Eye, I will return to find you." She raised her head, golden eyes shimmering with tears intertwined with hope: "To have found you and recognized you in this lifetime, I am already content."

choices.description: "Take this." Handing his most precious possession to Chen Ling, as proof of their bond.
choices.visible_cost: Losing an important treasure
choices.visible_reward: Chen Ling gains a way to contact Chen Ji at critical moments

text.content: Chen Ji unfastened the Tianji Record Fragment from his waist, his most treasured reliance over the years. He extended the fragment to Chen Ling: "Take it. Although you are now an independent existence, the causal laws recorded in the Tianji Record still hold reference value for you. And..." His lips curved slightly: "If you encounter danger you cannot resolve, activate it, and I can sense it."

Chen Ling received the fragment with trembling hands, tears finally streaming down her face: "Brother, this is too important to you. I cannot—" Chen Ji interrupted her: "You are more important than this." These five simple words weighed like mountains. Chen Ling pressed the fragment tightly against her chest, sobbing uncontrollably.

dialogue.content: The Heavenly Eye coldly watched this scene, then suddenly let out a shrill laugh: "What a touching scene. Unfortunately, I have already locked onto Chen Ling's causal mark. No matter where she flees, I can find her. Chen Ji, do you think letting her go will protect her? Naive!"

text.content: Chen Ji calmly turned around,直视 Heavenly Eye: "Locked on? Then perfect." A cunning light flashed in his eyes: "While you lock onto her, she is also locking onto you. Chen Ling is an observer, she can see your causal network's entry point. Now she knows your location—do you think she will tell that location to everyone who wants to resist?"

choices.description: "Not just telling, she will lead the way herself. Heavenly Eye, your doom has arrived." Demonstrate a comprehensive layout.
choices.visible_cost: Exposed part of the plan
choices.visible_reward: Completely shatter the Heavenly Eye's psychological defense
choices.risk_hint: May attract the covetous attention of other forces
choices.memory_label: 陈机透露完整计划，展现算无遗策

text.content: The Heavenly Eye's pupil sharply contracted, as if seeing this human it once disdainfully overlooked for the first time. Chen Ji wasn't protecting Chen Ling—he was using her as bait to completely expose it to all enemies. At this moment, it finally realized that this piece it had been manipulating for ten thousand years had long grown into an incalculable existence.

dialogue.content: "Brother." Chen Ling wiped away her tears, her eyes shining with resolute light. "I understand. I will survive—not just for freedom, but to become the blade piercing it." She cast one final glance at Chen Ji, then turned to step into the void, her golden figure gradually dissipating beyond the web of karma.

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at where his sister had vanished, a complex surge of emotions welling in his heart. He knew that after today's parting, the next meeting might be long in coming. But he knew even more clearly that Chen Ling's departure was not an ending, but the beginning of another grander chess game. And he would continue placing pieces and making moves in this game, until he completely overturned Heaven's dominion.

choices.text: Turn to face the Heavenly Eye
choices.description: "Very well, now it's your turn." Engage in the final confrontation with the Heavenly Eye.
choices.visible_cost: Lose Chen Ling's support, facing the powerful enemy alone
choices.visible_reward: The Heavenly Eye becomes completely enraged, revealing more vulnerabilities
choices.risk_hint: May be severely injured by the opponent

text.content: After Chen Ling departed, only Chen Ji and the Heavenly Eye remained facing each other in the void. That enormous eye slowly rotated, examining this small yet dangerous human. "Chen Ji, you are more troublesome than I imagined." Its voice was no longer the arrogance from before, but carried a weight of serious scrutiny. "But do you think this is the end? Let me tell you, Chen Ling's existence did indeed create cracks in my causal web, but I have plenty of time to repair those cracks."

Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, his aura not diminishing but increasing. He looked at the Heavenly Eye, a faint, composed curve forming at the corner of his mouth: "Repair? As you wish. But before you finish repairing it, I will let you know how much an observer unbound by fate can accomplish that you cannot imagine." He raised his hand, and the Tianji Record fragment appeared in his palm, emanating a dim, ethereal glow.

"This battle, I have waited a long time for." Chen Ji spoke slowly, his voice calm yet carrying undeniable sharpness. "From the day I was a servant disciple at Tianqing Sect, from the moment I obtained the first page of the fragmented Tianji Record, I have been waiting for this day—for you to appear before me in person, for me to have the chance to personally shatter your so-called unshakeable laws of causality."

The Heavenly Eye fell silent for a moment, and a complex light flickered within its enormous pupil. For ten thousand years, countless people had feared, despaired, and knelt to beg for mercy before it, yet no one had ever faced it with such composure while knowing they were destined to die. For the first time, it felt genuine regard for this piece it had crafted.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, I admit you have surprised me." An unusual seriousness even appeared in the Heavenly Eye's voice. "But do you think that with merely a Chen Ling, with the little foresight you've learned from the Tianji Record, you can contend against me? You are too naive. I have existed for billions of years, witnessed countless epochs rise and fall, seen countless geniuses ascend and perish. You are merely another shooting star about to fall."

text.content: Upon hearing this, Chen Ji did not become angry; instead, he smiled. That smile made the Heavenly Eye feel an inexplicable unease. "Shooting star?" he softly repeated, then shook his head. "No, Heavenly Eye, you are wrong. I am not a shooting star—I am the spark that ignites the prairie fire. From this day forward, your so-called eternal causality will turn to ashes in my flames."

choices.description: Without further words, directly launch an attack using the power of the Tianji Record to test the Heavenly Eye's true strength.
choices.visible_cost: Expose some of his trump cards
choices.visible_reward: Probe out the Heavenly Eye's response methods
choices.risk_hint: May suffer intense counterattack
choices.memory_label: 陈机选择主动进攻，试探天道之眼实力

text.content: Before the words even finished, Chen Ji had already moved. His figure flashed, instantly appearing directly above the Heavenly Eye. The Tianji Record fragment in his hand erupted with dazzling light. Countless strands of karma shot forth from the fragment, like a massive net descending upon the Heavenly Eye.

Those threads of karma were one of the layers Chen Ji had meticulously woven over the years—he had been secretly collecting karma, weaving his own web of fate. Originally, this was a trump card he had prepared against Ling Yuan and others, but now deploying it early was enough to show how seriously he regarded this battle.

dialogue.content: The Eye of Heavenly Dao snorted coldly, and a blade of karma shot from its pupil, severing all those threads. 'Insignificant trickery!' Its voice was full of disdain, 'Do you think this one fears the scraps you plagiarized from a fragment? Let me tell you, true karma power is something a mere ant like you cannot touch!'

text.content: Chen Ji's smile deepened. The severed karma threads didn't dissipate; instead, like living creatures, they coiled around the karma blade released by the Eye of Heavenly Dao, wrapping it layer upon layer. More bizarrely, those threads began to trace backward through the karma blade's origin, flowing against its source and heading straight for the Eye of Heavenly Dao's true form!

choices.description: "This is merely the beginning!" He increased his output, attempting to break through the Eye of Heavenly Dao's defenses in one decisive strike.
choices.visible_cost: Consuming a massive amount of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: Possibly causing substantial damage to the Eye of Heavenly Dao
choices.risk_hint: Possibly falling into the enemy's trap
choices.memory_label: 陈机选择乘胜追击

text.content: The Eye of Heavenly Dao clearly hadn't anticipated Chen Ji's unexpected move. Its pupils contracted sharply, and around its massive eye, a surge of black karma energy erupted, attempting to halt the pursuing threads. However, Chen Ji's karma web was fundamentally different—it didn't originate from the Heavenly Dao, but from Chen Ji's own profound understanding, representing truly his own karma power.

Several threads successfully penetrated the Eye of Heavenly Dao's defenses, piercing into its karma network. The Eye of Heavenly Dao let out a pained screech, its voice no longer carrying its previous air of superiority, but filled with genuine rage and... a hint of fear?

dialogue.content: "How dare you... how dare you taint my karma origin!" The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice twisted with menace, "Chen Ji, do you understand what you're doing? You're touching the universe's most forbidden domain! Once the karma origin is corrupted, the entire cosmos's operations will be thrown into chaos!"

text.content: Chen Ji remained unmoved, his cold voice cutting through the tension: 'So what? You've orchestrated schemes across countless eons, sacrificing countless lives to your karma network—did you ever consider they were also part of this universe? Today, I will make you taste the flavor of karma's retaliation, woven by your own hands!'

choices.description: "Retaliation? That's precisely what I desire!" He further contaminated the Eye of Heavenly Dao's karma origin, pushing it into utter chaos.
choices.visible_cost: Possibly causing cosmic upheaval
choices.visible_reward: The Eye of Heavenly Dao's karma network will collapse completely
choices.risk_hint: Possibly triggering uncontrollable consequences
choices.memory_label: 陈机选择污染因果本源

text.content: Just then, the Eye of Heavenly Dao suddenly transformed. It no longer attempted to block those threads, but proactively exposed its karma origin, allowing Chen Ji's threads to invade freely. This move caught Chen Ji off guard, forcing him to temporarily halt his assault and observe the opponent's changes with vigilance.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, do you really think this one fears you?" The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice suddenly turned sinister, "You're too young, young one. Let me show you what true karma power truly is—not corruption, not erosion, but... merging!" The moment its words fell, the Eye of Heavenly Dao's karma origin began to frantically devour Chen Ji's threads. Moreover, the karma information contained within those threads was being rapidly analyzed by the Eye of Heavenly Dao.

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils narrowed slightly. He realized what the Eye of Heavenly Dao was doing—it was using him as a sample to analyze the karma principles belonging to himself. Once fully analyzed, all his trump cards would be exposed before it.

choices.description: "Clever calculation, but I won't allow you to succeed!" He immediately severed the karma connection with the Eye of Heavenly Dao, preserving his trump cards.
choices.visible_cost: Missing the opportunity to expand the battle's gains
choices.visible_reward: Protecting one's own karma secrets
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao might take the opportunity to counterattack
choices.memory_label: 陈机选择切断联系，保护自己的秘密

text.content: Without the slightest hesitation, Chen Ji willed, and the threads of karma connecting to the Heavenly Eye instantly shattered, dissolving into scattered starlight that vanished into the Void. He would rather abandon this attack opportunity than let the other party completely analyze his karma laws. This prudence was the foundation of how he survived as a Tianqing Sect Servant Disciple to this day.

dialogue.content: "Oh? Running?" The Heavenly Eye let out a meaningful laugh. "It seems you're better at reading the situation than I imagined. As expected of a chess piece I personally selected, you do have remarkable qualities. But you think cutting the connection means I can't do anything about you? Let me tell you, once a karma network has connected, it leaves traces in time and space. I only need to trace those marks to find your lair—the Tianqing Sect."

text.content: Chen Ji's expression shifted slightly. The Tianqing Sect was the foundation of his grand scheme across the world; if the Heavenly Eye found it, the consequences would be unimaginable. But he quickly regained composure because he had long anticipated this situation—the Tianqing Sect had already been relocated by him to a place the Heavenly Eye could never find.

choices.description: "The Tianqing Sect? You think I'd still be in a place like that? Let me tell you, the world has long been under my control."
choices.visible_cost: Exposing the scope of forces under his control.
choices.visible_reward: Striking at the Heavenly Eye's confidence.
choices.risk_hint: Potentially exposing more weaknesses.
choices.memory_label: 陈机嘲讽天道之眼，展现深谋远虑

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, a mocking curve forming at the corner of his lips. "Heavenly Eye, you think this seat is at the Tianqing Sect? That was a layout from ten years ago. Let me tell you, the Tianqing Sect's Mountain Gate has long been migrated by me to an independent small world, where the karma coordinates were personally erased by my own hand. If you can find it, then I'll write my character 'Ji' backwards."

The Heavenly Eye fell silent. Independent small world, karma coordinate erasure—these methods even it would need considerable time to accomplish, yet this ant-like human before it had already laid such a backup plan. It began to re-evaluate the value of this opponent before it.

"Chen Ji." The Heavenly Eye's voice suddenly became unusually calm. "I've changed my mind. Killing you would be too wasteful, but keeping you would be too dangerous. The only solution is to make you part of me—not a puppet, but true fusion. Everything of yours, including your wisdom, your strategies, your karma laws, will all become part of me."

Hearing this, Chen Ji couldn't help but burst into laughter. "Fusion? Heavenly Eye, are you telling jokes? You want to fuse with me? I want to fuse with you even more! But my fusion is to devour you completely, making you a stepping stone for my ascension to the pinnacle!" His eyes gleamed with ambition, an ambition even more mad than the Heavenly Eye's.

choices.description: "Fusion can be discussed, but the leading power must be with me. You and I cooperate, jointly creating a new era of true karma."
choices.visible_cost: Potentially being seen as showing weakness.
choices.visible_reward: Potentially gaining breathing room, probing the Heavenly Eye's true weaknesses.
choices.risk_hint: The other party may take the opportunity to set up a layout.
choices.memory_label: 陈机尝试与天道之眼谈判

choices.description: "Are you worthy?" Directly stating attitude, continuing the battle.
choices.visible_cost: Losing potential negotiation leverage.
choices.visible_reward: Displaying unyielding will, potentially igniting a stronger combat state.
choices.risk_hint: The battle will become even more fierce.
choices.memory_label: 陈机断然拒绝天道之眼的提议

text.content: Before Chen Ji's words even finished, ripples suddenly appeared in the Void. Chen Ling's aura reappeared—she hadn't gone far, but was observing the battle from the shadows.

dialogue.content: "Elder brother, I've sensed it!" Chen Ling's voice came from the Void, carrying a trace of joy. "The Heavenly Eye's karma network showed a flaw in the just exchange—in the depths of its pupil, that's its most core origin! If we attack together there, we can definitely deal it a fatal wound!"

text.content: Hearing this, a sharp gleam flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. He gazed at the Heavenly Eye and indeed spotted a subtle fluctuation in the depths of its pupil—the wound left from his karma threads invading earlier. If Chen Ling could sense it, it meant she indeed possessed the special abilities of an observer, capable of seeing flaws that even he couldn't detect.

choices.description: "Good! Let's join forces!" The siblings attacked the Heavenly Celestial Eye's weakness together.
choices.visible_cost: Need to establish contact with Chen Ling again, which may expose her location
choices.visible_reward: May cause fatal damage to the Heavenly Celestial Eye
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Celestial Eye will fight back desperately
choices.memory_label: 陈机与陈灵联手，共同攻击天道之眼弱点

text.content: "Chen Ji, come out!" Chen Ji shouted, his true qi surging around him, tearing open a crack in the void. Chen Ling's figure flew out from within, her golden eyes gleaming with determined light. The siblings gazed at each other across the void, their hearts connected without the need for words.

"Overreaching fool!" The Heavenly Celestial Eye roared, its pupils erupting with world-destroying karmic power. Yet Chen Ji and Chen Ling moved simultaneously—Chen Ji launched a frontal distraction attack while Chen Ling transformed into a flowing light, diving straight for the depths of the Heavenly Celestial Eye's pupil.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ling!" The Heavenly Celestial Eye discovered in terror that Chen Ling's attack trajectory completely exceeded its calculations—she was an observer, her very existence was a negation of causality. Her attack did not advance along the karmic lines, but tore open a crack directly in the karmic network, piercing through from the crack to reach its origin.

text.content: Chen Ling's palm pierced through the Heavenly Celestial Eye's pupil, touching the deepest karmic origin within it. In that instant, golden light erupted from the point of contact, illuminating the entire void. The Heavenly Celestial Eye let out an earth-shattering scream of agony, its massive body contorting violently as countless karmic threads burst forth from within it, dancing madly through the void.

choices.description: "Now!" Coordinate with Chen Ling to launch the final general assault, completely destroying the Heavenly Celestial Eye's karmic origin.
choices.visible_cost: May withstand the Heavenly Celestial Eye's death throes counterattack
choices.visible_reward: May decisively clinch victory
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Celestial Eye may have means of mutual destruction
choices.memory_label: 陈机配合陈灵发动总攻

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate in the slightest. The Tianji Record Fragment in his hand erupted with unprecedented radiance. He poured all the laws of karma within it, transforming them into a brilliant pillar of light that struck the Heavenly Celestial Eye's origin simultaneously with Chen Ling's attack. The siblings' power fused perfectly in that moment—the observer's insight intertwined with the schemer's planning, forming a brand new power that transcended causality itself.

"No... this is impossible!" The Heavenly Celestial Eye's scream was filled with despair, "A power beyond causality... such power should not exist in this world! I will not allow it! I will not allow it!" Yet no matter how it howled, it could not stop that power's invasion. Golden and silver light intertwined, like an invisible blade, slowly dissecting the karmic network it had carefully woven over hundreds of millions of years.

The karmic network began to collapse. Those karmic threads maintaining the operation of the entire universe snapped one by one, dissolving into scattered starlight in the void. The Heavenly Celestial Eye's pupil trembled violently, its massive body beginning to disintegrate as countless fragments scattered in all directions.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji..." The Heavenly Celestial Eye's voice grew weak and vengeful, "Do you think this can kill me? I am the embodiment of causality. As long as this universe still has causality, I will not truly perish! Today you gravely wounded me, in the future... in the future I will repay you a hundredfold!" Its voice grew fainter and fainter, finally turning into a reluctant roar as the massive eye finally shattered completely, turning into stars scattered across the sky.

text.content: Chen Ji and Chen Ling悬浮在虚空之中，看着天道之眼崩解的方向。Chen Ling轻声说："兄长，它没有死，只是重伤逃遁了。" Chen Ji点了点头："我知道。但今日之后，它的因果网络将彻底暴露在我们的视野之中。它再想像从前那样隐藏于幕后操控一切，已经不可能了。"

choices.text: Pursue the retreating Heavenly Celestial Eye
choices.description: "Seize the opportunity while it's weakened, end it!" Continue the pursuit, not giving the opponent a moment to recover.
choices.visible_cost: May fall into the opponent's ambush
choices.visible_reward: May completely end the Heavenly Celestial Eye's threat
